scope.aggregate: mean across mapping tasks, not a confidence interval
scope.budget: global cooperative limit between calls; use outer process timeout
scope.controls: same receptor/output wiring; no training or deranged train targets
scope.epochs: repeated presentations; not independent new observations
given: three slots and three part values
independent source and target SDR codebooks with slot blocks
permutation-and-relabeling transformation family in the evaluator
assignment of training pairs to each of two mapping tasks
scope.learned: SDR-to-SDR mappings from separately grouped supervised pairs
not_tested: discovery of a transformation family or a new context
unseen primitive values, slots, or transformation types
learning encoders, words, concepts or dialogue

source.reproducibility: scores/counts deterministic for matching source and dependencies; hashes identify but do not embed source; wall-clock timings are not deterministic
